g.text: Accepts digits only, within the int range, and at least 1.
parseListRecipe wraps in a MishMashException that ends
confirmationPrompt(book) returns an empty Optional, so no question is asked.
[recipes is empty, or index exceeds recipes.size()]
The caller displays the error followed by all command formats.
Without an index, parseListRecipe creates ListRecipeCommand() and execute builds the
numbered list itself ("Recipes:" plus one line per recipe, or "No recipes yet...").
No viewer is used and an empty book is not an error. Neither path changes the book.
